title: Quest 3/3S: pin device profiles to the Quest 2 baseline and document supported headsets (P-31)
acceptance: Meta_Quest_3 and Meta_Quest_3S device profiles apply the same rendering settings as Oculus_Quest2
An automation test loads the device profiles and checks the pinned values
docs/TOOLCHAIN.md lists the supported headsets, controllers and refresh rate
description: From ADR-0003. The engine's Quest 2 profile sets sg.ShadowQuality=1 but its Quest 3/3S profiles do not, so without project profiles Quest 3 would render differently from Quest 2. No Quest-3-only quality increase in this task.
